Primary maths topics

Primary Fractions Games and Practice.

Practise halves, quarters, equivalent fractions, fraction calculations and connections with decimals and percentages across Years 1–6.

Start maths practice

Start with equal parts.

A half is one of two equal parts. A quarter is one of four equal parts. Use shapes, objects and number lines to show what the fraction means.

Find equivalent fractions.

One half and two quarters have the same value. Pictures and calculations help children explain equivalence before harder fraction operations.

Connect fractions, decimals and percentages.

Later primary practice links fractions to decimal notation, percentages and calculations. Choose a year or skill that matches the child’s current teaching.

Choose relevant practice by year.

Year 1

Addition, subtraction and number bonds to 20. Equal groups, halves, quarters, time, money, measures and shapes.
